verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with a downloadable OpenAPI spec, an interactive playground, a deprecation policy, a CLI and an MCP server. None of the items mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. An OpenAPI spec is only a building block from which a developer could generate a client, and the CLI and MCP server are separate capabilities, so none of these count toward an official SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
